name: Tachina
source:
A girl from a small Eastern island nation.

She was the concubine of a lord whose lineage died out due to a big fire 20 years ago. She is quiet and reserved. She was loved immensely by her former lord, but suffered terrible treatment at the hands of the jealous queen. Now, she is said to be a ghost wandering around the old castle...
